run_episode_interactive: run an interactive Melting Pot episode with pygame rendering and keyboard controls
run_episode_random_agent: run a Melting Pot episode with a random agent action map without pygame rendering
create_action_reader: create an ActionReader that converts keyboard inputs to environment actions for a given player
get_player_direction: get the direction pressed by the player using WASD or arrow keys
get_player_turn: get the turn increment from Q/E or page up/down keys for player rotation
